modules.reason: The purposeful planner's own choices, hosted by the planner: waiting, standing a while, stopping to talk, and going to rest at or visit a place, by the routine catalog's rules and draws, byte for byte as every purposeful society runs them. Its events are the planner's own.

parameters.name: hearing_reach_mm
parameters.reason: How far a line carries: every being within it whose kind offers hearing hears it, the routine's own reach for two people stopping to talk.

parameters.name: lines_heard_maximum
parameters.reason: How many lines each being keeps, the oldest dropped first, so what it is shown of a conversation stays bounded however long the world talks.

parameters.name: line_characters_maximum
parameters.reason: The most characters of one line, as the line rule counts them, at which a decider's line is checked before it is said.

modules.reason: A line a being's decider chose to say, a model chosen for it or the outside program that sent it, said where the being stood as the minute began, heard within reach and kept by each hearer. The routine never says anything.

parameters.name: quiet_minutes
parameters.reason: How many minutes in a row a visitor's program may leave unanswered (no live connection, or no answer in time) before the visitor goes home; each kind states its own.

modules.reason: A visitor from another program going home: by its decider's choice, or when its program stays quiet for as many minutes as its kind waits, taking what it holds.

parameters.name: reach_mm
parameters.reason: How near a being stands to a thing it picks up: a person's reach, the society's object reach. Two beings hand a thing over within it or within the walking graph's longest step between two joined nodes, whichever is farther, so beings on neighbouring nodes can always hand over.

parameters.name: approach_mm
parameters.reason: How far a thing, or a being a thing is handed to or taken from, may be for a hands act to be offered: the being walks to stand within reach first. The society's hearing reach, so whoever can be spoken to can be walked to.

parameters.name: walk_minutes_maximum
parameters.reason: How many minutes a being may walk toward what its hands act is for before the act is dropped, named out_of_reach: a thing carried away or a being that keeps moving is not chased for ever.

modules.reason: Picking a holdable thing up into a free socket that fits it, putting it down where the being stands, handing it to a being that offers to receive it, and taking it from one that lets it be taken: a being chosen to act walks to stand within reach first, and acts in the minute it arrives.

parameters.name: follow_distance_mm
parameters.reason: How near a follower keeps to the one it follows.

parameters.name: lost_after_minutes
parameters.reason: How many minutes the one followed may stay out of reach before the follower stops.

modules.reason: Keeping near another being that offers to be followed, re-planned each minute, until the follower chooses anything else or loses it.

parameters.name: reach_mm
parameters.reason: How far a being notices others and loose things: farther than a line carries (the say module's 8,000 mm), as one sees farther than one hears, and within the reach of the places its options offer.

parameters.name: beings_maximum
parameters.reason: The most other beings a decider is shown near a being, nearest first; the rest within reach are counted, so a crowd is a number and not a list.

parameters.name: things_maximum
parameters.reason: The most loose things a decider is shown near a being, nearest first; the rest within reach are counted.

parameters.name: bytes_maximum
parameters.reason: The most bytes of canonical JSON the block takes in a request, the farthest entry dropped and counted first, so with the options, the lines heard and said and what a being remembers it stays within the request's context bound.

parameters.name: offers_version
parameters.reason: The version of the offers catalog whose words say what a noticed thing is good for, so a later catalog never changes what a stored request showed.

modules.reason: What a being notices as its minute begins, built by rule from the society's state and input when its decider is asked: where it stands, the beings near it with what each is doing and holding and whether it hears this one, and the loose things near it with what each is good for. It holds no state and records no event.

parameters.name: beings_maximum
parameters.reason: The most beings a being remembers meeting, each with how and the last line each said to the other; a new one replaces the one noted longest ago.

parameters.name: places_maximum
parameters.reason: The most places a being remembers arriving at; a new one replaces the one noted longest ago.

parameters.name: handed_maximum
parameters.reason: The most hand-overs a being remembers; a new one replaces the oldest.

parameters.name: bytes_maximum
parameters.reason: The most bytes of canonical JSON the block a decider is shown takes, the entry noted longest ago dropped first.

modules.reason: What a being a model or a program decides for remembers: written last in each minute's things phase from that minute's events alone, never by a model, and kept bounded in its state; shown to its decider as what happened here, not instructions. A being the routine alone decides for keeps none.

The purposeful planner's choices as version 1 makes them, for the beings whose kinds list them: the routine plans, and a decider is offered, only the activities among stand, talk, rest and visit that a being's kind lists, and a talk only between two beings whose kinds both list talk; waiting is everybody's, and a being whose kind does not rest is never tired, since only resting relieves it. A society of things records it in its first input once it is built, and one that recorded version 1 runs version 1 for its whole life.

parameters.reason: How far a thing, or a being a thing is handed to or taken from, may be for a hands act to be offered: the being walks to stand within reach first. The society's hearing reach, so whoever can be spoken to can be walked to.

parameters.name: walk_minutes_maximum
parameters.reason: How many minutes a being may walk toward what its hands act is for before the act is dropped, named out_of_reach: a thing carried away or a being that keeps moving is not chased for ever.

modules.reason: Hands as version 1 serves them, with one change to where a being walks to act: of the open nodes of the walking graph within reach of the thing, or of the being it hands a thing to or takes one from, it walks to the one nearest itself, so it comes up on its own side and never walks past or through what it acts on, where version 1 walks to the open node nearest the thing or the being. A society of things records it in its first input once it is built, and one that recorded version 1 runs version 1 for its whole life.

parameters.name: follow_distance_mm
parameters.reason: How near a follower keeps to the one it follows.

parameters.name: lost_after_minutes
parameters.reason: How many minutes in a row the follower may end farther off than the follow distance with no open node within it before it stops following, so one it can no longer come near is let go.

modules.reason: Keeping near another being that offers to be followed, chosen by a being's decider: each minute it has nothing else under way it waits within the follow distance of the one it follows, or walks to the open node within that distance nearest itself, a stand under way ending for the walk; it stops when its decider chooses anything but going on or saying something, when the one followed leaves, or after the lost minutes in a row ending farther off with nowhere to stand within the distance. The first version was stated and never built, so no society records it; a society of things records this one in its first input from when it was built.

parameters.name: quiet_minutes

modules.reason: A visitor from another program going home, as version 1: by its decider's choice, or when its program stays quiet for as many minutes as its kind waits, taking what it holds. Every summary the society's events and its people's explanations give of a visitor names it by what it is, from outside and decided by its own program or by this world, never as simulated, and a crossing refused before anybody arrived as from outside. A society of things records it in its first input once it is built; one that recorded version 1 names its visitors as version 1 did.
